title: Network approach of mood and functional gastrointestinal symptom dynamics in relation to childhood trauma in patients with irritable bowel syndrome and comorbid panic disorder
limitations: - Small sample size; - Limited trauma groups (only low-trauma and non-trauma); - Low statistical power; - Multiple testing without Bonferroni correction; - Convergence issues in regression models.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are available. The authors mention using Stata for analysis and qgraph for visualization, but do not declare availability in the main text. The paper was not found to be preregistered.
